pages.text: It wakes asking questions. It talks to whoever stands near, in whispers.$(br2)Use it to see what it sees. At first that is nothing: it needs $(l)nerves$().

pages.title: Ganglion
pages.text: Graft a $(l)Ganglion$() onto an organism within thirty-two blocks of the Chronocortex and the organism is wired in. It then appears in its view: what it holds, whether it hungers, and how close a Time organism is to tearing.$(br2)It warns me, aloud, before one bursts.

pages.title: Moving It
pages.text: Do not. Breaking the jar kills what is inside, and only the table is left.
